chunks: And what Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhl narrated from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Ubayd ibn Zurarah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I heard him say: 'Ten sucklings do not prohibit anything.'
ai.seo_question: How many breastfeedings are required to make marriage prohibited between individuals in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the threshold for establishing mahram status through breastfeeding, specifying that exactly ten sucklings are required to create a permanent marital prohibition. This ruling is central to the Shia jurisprudence of radha', distinguishing it from other schools that may vary on whether the count refers to distinct feedings or total milk intake, and underscores the precision required in determining kinship ties for marriage validity.
